localChanges: A Diplomat walking into a rival's city now asks what it should do: steal a technology, sabotage the city's production or one of its buildings, or incite a revolt that brings the city and the units around it over to you. A city can only be robbed once, and the capital can't be incited (#58).
Inciting a revolt shows its price first, and at peace you can subvert the city for double instead, which keeps the treaty. Stealing or inciting at peace asks before it breaks the treaty (#58).

A Diplomat can also bribe a lone enemy unit outside a city to join you, ships and aircraft included, without being used up. Whoever is on the receiving end is told about each theft, sabotage, revolt and bribe (#58).
